correctness.rationale: Necessity follows by applying pro-star-reversibility to u u^{-1}=1; sufficiency follows from central projection decomposition in a star-reversible ring and self-adjointness of two explicit units, yielding b^*a=ab for every projected product.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 source introduces pro-star-reversibility but does not discuss units or invertibility, while the 2013 star-reversible literature predates this notion. No equivalent unit-group criterion was located in the inspected literature; concurrent or differently named coverage remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The criterion exactly identifies the obstruction separating star-reversibility from pro-star-reversibility and yields strong consequences for unit groups, Jacobson radicals, clean and semiperfect rings, local and Artinian rings, and division rings.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
